Order 
This fourth application is filed by the applicant under Section 439 of CR.P.C./483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.R.C. 0092019S0013 registered at P.S. Central Investigation of Bureau Unit- A.C.B. District Jabalpur (M.P.) for offence under Sections 406, 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC.
2.

sentences.text: On 17.11.2025, counsel for the applicant was not present and in the interest of justice, the court has adjourned the matter for today.
Today, also when the matter is called out in first half, none appeared for the applicant.
In the second half also, when the matter is again recalled, none appeared for the applicant.

The counsel for the respondent/CBI is present and has pointed out that petitions filed by the co-accused persons have already been withdrawn by the concerned co-accused persons,
more over, he has submitted that considering the allegation about cloning of cheques and by defrauding the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:62520 2 MCRC-43517-2025 huge amount, no relief can be granted to the present applicant.
3.
Considering this aspect and considering the reply which is filed by the respondent/CBI, of which relevant paragraphs No. 2 to 9 are reproduced herein under:

"2. The allegation, as per the FIR, is that the Land Acquisition Office, Bargi Canal Diversion Project, Katni, Madhya Pradesh, the LAO/Katni has opened and maintains account with various Banks including an account (A/c No.2138843611) at the Central Bank of India, Katni Branch, Katni, Madhya Pradesh, which had a credit balance of Rs. 5,05,51,027.30 as of 06/09/2017for disbursing the compensation to the eligible Subhashisa Sarkar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97313953/
1 farmers in Katni for the acquisition of their land for the Bargi Diversion Project.

sentences.text:
The 11 fraudsters opened accounts at various banks in Kolkata, including SBI, UCO Bank,
Bank of Baroda, Union Bank of India, and Punjab National Bank.

Using 53 cloned and forged cheques in the name of the Land Acquisition Office, they presented these cheques at the respective banks/branches in Jabalpur and got them cleared through the Central Bank of India.
This resulted wrongful loss to the Land Acquisition Office and corresponding wrongful gain of Rs. 4,09,84,470.00 to the 11 fraudsters.
However, the original 53 cheques remain with the LAO office, Katni.
3. That, cheques cloned for perpetuating the crime are related to Central Bank of India, Katni Branch.
These cloned cheques had been cleared and the proceeds got credited in the 11 bank accounts located at Kolkata
Efforts have been taken to locate and apprehend the FIR named accused persons, but the addresses given in the Account Opening Forms were found fictitious.
Cash Reward has been declared and the photographs of the accused persons have also been displayed on CBI site as well as got displayed in the local newspaper at Kolkata during the year 2020.
4. That, during investigation in the instant case it is found that 06 accused persons are residing in the District Kolkata and other districts of state of West Bengal.

5. That, on prayer of CBI, the Hon'ble Court of Special Judicial Magistrate, CBI,
Jabalpur had issued non-bailable warrant of arrest dated 20-11-2024 against accused namely Subhasis Sarkar alias @ Joy Dhar and in execution of said arrest warrant, Sh.
Subhasis Sarkar S/o late Uttam Sarkar was arrested on 28-11- 2024.

entities.text:
Court of Special Judicial Magistrate, CBI,
Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Thereafter,
accused applicant Subhasis Sarkar was produced before the Court of ACJM, Sealdah,
24 PGS South, Kolkata with prayer to issue transit remand.
Upon said prayer, the Hon'ble Court of ACJM has granted transit remand of the accused applicant 6.

That, during investigation, an Identification Panchnama dated 21.12.2024 was prepared by the IO in presence of witness namely Shri Arvind Kumar Thakur, Sainik,
O/o GM, Vigilance, Eastern Railway, Kolkata.

During the said Panchnama proceeding, on NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:62520 3 MCRC-43517-2025 being shown the photographs of account holder i.e. Shri Joy Dhar available in the Account Opening Forms of SB account no.26050110020432 in the name of Joy Dhar opened in UCO Bank, Phoolbaghan Branch, Kolkata on 20.10.2016 to Ms. Pinky Sarkar D/o Late Uttar Sarkar, she had identified that photographs of account holder as her brother namely Shri Subhasis Sarkar S/o Late Uttam Sarkar.

It established that accused Subhasis Sarkar had opened aforesaid SB account by impersonation as Joy Dhar and thereafter cheated O/o LAO, Bargi Diversion Project,
Katni by encashment of 05 forged cheques which are bearing forged signatures of LAO.

7. That, accused applicant Subhasis Sarkar committed fraud through his accounts,
obtained illegal funds and derived undue benefits through the cheque of LAO bearing Subhashisa Sarkar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97313953/
2 no: - Chq no. 12040:
amount Rs. 595781, Chq no. 12055: amount Rs. 635771, Chq no. 12052: amount Rs.
911771, Chq no. 12049: amount Rs. 998782, Chq no. 12073: amount Rs. 995787, total amounting to Rs.41,37,892/- .
8.

That, the Chargesheet against the accused applicant and three other co-accused persons has been filed in Court U/s 120B, 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471of IPC with further investigation continued against other accused persons and for collection of additional evidence against accused applicant.

9. That, thereafter on completion of investigation a supplementary Charge-sheet against the other co-accused has been filed in Court of Special Judicial Magistrate,
CBI, Jabalpur U/s 120B r/w 419, 420, 467, 468 & 471 of IPC & substantive offence u/s 409 of IPC and 13(2) r/w 13(1)(c) & (d) of the PC Act,1988.
Thereafter, court of special judicial magistrate, CBI.
Jabalpur vide order dated 14.07.2025, trail of this case has been committed to the court of special Judge, CBI, Jabalpur."

4. Considering the same, I am of the opinion that in fact, applicant is not interested in prosecuting this petition after filing the same and on merit also considering the affidavit filed by the CBI, I found that the application for regular bail filed by the present application is not required to be entertained more particularly, considering the fact that the co-accused persons have also withdrawn the bail application.
5.
Accordingly, present application is also dismissed.

(SANDEEP N. BHATT) JUDGE NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:62520 4 MCRC-43517-2025 b Subhashisa Sarkar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97313953/
